name: claude-code-visual-manager

scripts.start: npm run build --prefix client && node server/index.js
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client

description: Claude Code Visual Manager v5.0.0 — graphical UI for Claude Code CLI with live terminal, job runner, swarm orchestrator, and N8N-style workflow editor.
